probability.description: The chance of taming the entity with each item use between 0.0 and 1.0, where 1.0 is 100%

tame_event.description: Event to fire when the entity is tamed. Can be an object with event and target properties, or a simple event string.

tame_items.description: The list of items that can be used to tame this entity

oneOf.description: List of item objects with optional result_item for items that can be used to tame this entity.

item.description: The item identifier that can be used to tame this entity.

result_item.description: The item that is given back to the player when they tame the entity. If not specified, the item used to tame is consumed.
